name: Arepo
summary: A massively parallel code for gravitational N-body and hydrodynamics simulations, including cosmological setups.
scope: DIPL models and native input generation for the 16 bundled examples in the pinned public Arepo source.
validation_qualifier: Locally verified on 2026-10-09: 38 tests and 28 subtests passed with SciNumTools3 0.9.0 against the pinned Arepo source. CI and physical simulation runs remain separate checks.
limitations: Active settings are compared for bundled examples; comments, ordering, file bytes, builds, and physical simulation results are outside that comparison. Upstream endorsement is not established.
